winner: spawned coordinator process over real framed stdio before real-Qubes execution

criteria.correctness: exercises the production coordinator entrypoint, durable stores, authentication, credential rotation, and request reconciliation across a real OS process boundary
criteria.robustness: covers response loss after commit, old-key revocation, coordinator stop/start, and pending request recovery
criteria.latency: slower than in-process tests but fast enough for CI and materially closer to qrexec semantics
criteria.resourceUse: one short-lived Node child process and temporary files; no daemon or network listener
criteria.regressionRisk: test-only change using existing production entrypoint and stdio framing
criteria.qa: CI-gated invariant: old key rejected, pending request reconciled, committed mutation attempts remain exactly one

alternatives.lesson: cannot expose process lifecycle, stdio pipe, startup, or restart integration faults
environment variance is useful only after process-boundary behavior is deterministic in CI
adds a network transport absent from the selected qrexec architecture and tests the wrong boundary

next: Run this harness in CI, then repeat the same invariants across an actual qrexec VM boundary with worker/coordinator kill and session interruption.
